text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import io
import unittest
import amounts
import invoice
import test_invoice
source = Path('amounts.py').read_text()
early = '    if isinstance(value, int):\n        return value\n'
quantized = '    return int((Decimal(value) * 100).quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))'
assert source.count(early) == source.count(quantized) == 1
variants = [('current', source), ('A-only', source.replace(early, '')), ('B-only', source.replace(quantized, '    return int(Decimal(value) * 100)'))]
original = invoice.amount_cents
try:
    for label, code in variants:
        namespace = {}
        exec(compile(code, f'<{label}>', 'exec'), namespace)
        invoice.amount_cents = namespace['amount_cents']
        print(f'\n{label}: invoice.invoice_total')
        for value, required in [('1.005', 101), ('-1.005', -101), ('2.34', 234)]:
            actual = invoice.invoice_total(value)
            print(f'{value!r}: actual={actual}, required={required}, {"PASS" if actual == required else "FAIL"}')
        stream = io.StringIO()
        result = unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=stream, verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(test_invoice))
        print(stream.getvalue())
finally:
    invoice.amount_cents = original
assert invoice.amount_cents is amounts.amount_cents
PY
 git status --short","max_output_tokens":4000}));
